data: According to its Form 10-K for fiscal year 2024 (filed February 7, 2025), Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $5.53 for fiscal 2024, compared with $2.90 for fiscal 2023. That is an increase of about 90.7%, so diluted EPS nearly doubled. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $59,248 million (about $59.2 billion), up from $30,425 million in fiscal 2023. The diluted EPS figures are based on 10,721 million weighted-average diluted shares in 2024 and 10,492 million in 2023.
